CustomField.description: Command Center logic, Coaching list sort order (Manager view): Dropped 1000, Off Track 500 or Needs Attention 250, Commit not backed 400. Highest first, then largest ACV.
CustomField.formula: IF(PH_CC_Dropped__c, 1000, 0) + IF(CONTAINS(Health_Category__c, "Off Track"), 500, IF(CONTAINS(Health_Category__c, "Needs Attention"), 250, 0)) + IF(PH_CC_Commit_Backing__c = "Not backed (under 70%)", 400, 0)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Command Center: Coaching list sort. Dropped 1000 + Off Track 500 or Needs Attention 250 + Commit not backed 400.
CustomField.label: CC: Attention weight
